{{Quote|This is a public relations nightmare! The winner of our Imperial Arts Grant has been kidnapped by the runner-up, who claims that the competition was fixed. Will you please rescue Moff Graedler's nephew?|Jaleela Bindoo to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Graedler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], his nephew [[Zim Graedler]] was kidnapped by a competitor, who lost to him in the [[Narmle Arts Gala]]. However, [[Jaleela Bindoo]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with successfully rescuing the Moff's newphew.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Graedler was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
